items.item_text: Recent or current experience in caring for LGBTQ and diverse patient populations.
Provide direct outpatient clinical care in all aspects of family medicine for children and adults, inclusive of prenatal care.
Provide clinical teaching and supervision of residents and medical students in the outpatient setting.
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team to enhance patient outcomes and ensure the highest standards of care.
Ensure medical documentation within the Epic Electronic Health Record system is accurate, completed in a timely fashion, and maintained in accordance with institutional policies.
Provide coverage for clinic telephone and EMR inbox communications, as well as responding to faxed messages. As needed, coverage may extend to after-hours, weekends, and holidays.
Participate in administrative meetings held to support departmental initiatives and clinical operations while adhering to all relevant department and clinic policies.
Recent or current practice caring for hospitalized adult and pediatric hospital inpatients.
